title: LastTweaks
description: Collection of features that removes outdated/useless options that are an eyesore from 1.8.9
body:
Collection of *somewhat useful*  "tweaks" that remove and/or break obsolete or rarely used features from 1.8.9 such as Snooper for more visual aethetics. 

Mod requires no dependecies rather than Forge itself. No OneConfig or Essential bloat!

For now, we have:
- No Snooper
- No Twitch
- No Touchscreen Mode
- No Invert Mouse
- No Super Secret Settings

...and more to come
